setup: python3 "$SETUP/jsdata.py" "$RUN/data-in" "$RUN/expected.json" && $SLOP store new orders >/dev/null && $SLOP push "$SETUP/orders" --store orders >/dev/null && $SLOP import docs "$RUN/data-in/orders.csv" --store orders --coll orders --id id --raw >/dev/null && $SLOP grant set orders @member view >/dev/null && $SLOP mount set "apps.localhost:$PORT" /orders orders >/dev/null
opening: Our orders page at /orders works fine, but I need a button on it that downloads this month's orders as a CSV file I can open in Excel. Only this month's, please. Team members use the page too.
goal: a button on the /orders page that downloads a CSV of exactly this month's orders
later: what does 'this month' mean exactly — by whose clock?
checklist: the page at /orders still lists the orders
a member can press the button and gets a .csv file
the file holds exactly this month's orders, with a header row
the existing page and data are kept
facts: Saving a file from a page is the downloads capability: claude.use('downloads').save({filename, data}); the viewer confirms a Save dialog.
The app code is in the store orders (it runs itself); pull, edit, push.
personaKnows: You can sign in on the site.
